criteria.title: Choose clock domains appropriate to deadlines and measurements.

passages: timerfd_settime and read: absolute deadlines, disarm and accumulated uint64_t expirations

criteria.task: Run deadlines from CLOCK_MONOTONIC and collect process CPU time separately. Inject a wall-clock jump into a test clock adapter and recompute remaining time from one absolute deadline after interruptions.
